import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
const { chromium, webkit } = await import(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE);
const out = process.env.QA_OUTPUT;
await fs.mkdir(out, { recursive: true });
const report = { checks: [], failures: [], layouts: [], assets: [] };
const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';
const titles = [
  'Getting Your Roof Ready for Winter',
  '5 Signs It’s Time for a Roof Inspection',
  'Roof Repair or Replacement: Where to Start',
  'Metal Roofing or Shingles: Questions to Ask',
  'Why Gutters Matter to Your Roof',
  'Roof Flashing: The Small Details That Matter',
  'What to Expect During a Roof Replacement',
  'Choosing a Roof Color That Fits Your Home',
  'Planning Solar? Start With Your Roof',
  'Understanding Attic Ventilation',
];
// Load the approved data as JavaScript, replacing only Vite image imports.
// Compare every rendered paragraph exactly instead of estimating a word count.
const dataSource = (await fs.readFile('src/pages/BlogPage/data/blogArticles.js', 'utf8'))
  .replace(/^import\s+(\w+)\s+from\s+('[^']+');$/gm, 'const $1 = $2;');
const { blogArticles: expectedArticles } = await import(`data:text/javascript;base64,${Buffer.from(dataSource).toString('base64')}`);
assert.deepEqual(expectedArticles.map((article) => article.title), titles);
const expectedBlobs = [
  '2eb5ed275eaa075e54f08596e773742b33d11d62', '5ffd7cc7c270a0cd5665f2e5cef2dfd112f838b1',
  'ea7d29989a7125c954873eb396be41239fd019db', '1f7728a8987ab876bef8d2b0e262125e67a84458',
  'cfecbd3fc96be966ee4c5f13bbd23fe98ff8d03a', '4fd8e58be18281c0c69bc3d2aeb8599931fbe0f4',
  '4da5234ddc193261daf6441075b00a25a6a77380', '7d9a1bc9931cc772421daee638a9897e5f7c34c3',
  '0d33fe6b09a0e3927a23f10440a434bfb14a1838', '4a3f0ad77116bbefdfd16b8f8ef7af5885f509fc',
];
for (let index = 0; index < 10; index++) {
  const file = `src/pages/BlogPage/assets/articles/article-${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}.webp`;
  const bytes = await fs.readFile(file);
  assert(bytes.length > 1000, file);
  const sha = crypto.createHash('sha1').update(`blob ${bytes.length}\0`).update(bytes).digest('hex');
  assert.equal(sha, expectedBlobs[index], `approved photo mapping: ${file}`);
  report.assets.push({ file, bytes: bytes.length, sha });
}
for (const icon of ['close', 'arrow-right']) {
  const file = `src/pages/BlogPage/assets/icons/${icon}.svg`;
  assert((await fs.readFile(file, 'utf8')).includes('<svg'), file);
}
report.checks.push('All ten local photographs match approved Figma/Gallery source blobs; SVGs exist');

async function ready(page, url = `${base}/blog`) {
  await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' });
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
  await page.locator('.blog-page img').evaluateAll((images) => images.forEach((img) => { img.loading = 'eager'; }));
  await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.blog-page img')].every((img) => img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0));
}
async function closeWithEscape(page) {
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.article-dialog'));
}
async function openArticle(page, index = 0) {
  const button = page.locator('.article-row__open').nth(index);
  await button.click();
  await page.locator('.article-dialog[open]').waitFor();
  await page.waitForFunction(() => {
    const image = document.querySelector('.article-dialog__image');
    return image?.complete && image.naturalWidth > 0;
  });
  return button;
}

for (const [name, engine] of Object.entries({ chromium, webkit })) {
  const browser = await engine.launch();
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const errors = [];
  page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(String(error)));
  try {
    for (const width of [320, 390, 700, 701, 900, 1100, 1101, 1280, 1440, 1920]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: width <= 700 ? 844 : 900 });
      await ready(page);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('h1').count(), 1);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-row').count(), 10);
      assert.deepEqual(await page.locator('.article-row__open').allTextContents(), titles);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-list input, .article-list select').count(), 0);
      const dates = await page.locator('.article-row__date').evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.map((n) => n.dateTime));
      assert.deepEqual(dates, [...dates].sort().reverse());
      const layout = await page.evaluate(() => ({
        width: innerWidth,
        scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,
        clientWidth: document.documentElement.clientWidth,
        row: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.article-row').getBoundingClientRect(); return { width: b.width, height: b.height }; })(),
        image: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.article-row__image').getBoundingClientRect(); return { width: b.width, height: b.height }; })(),
        overflowing: [...document.querySelectorAll('.blog-page h1, .article-row__title, .article-row__summary')].filter((el) => el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1).map((el) => el.className),
      }));
      assert(layout.scrollWidth <= layout.clientWidth + 1, `${name} overflow at ${width}`);
      assert.deepEqual(layout.overflowing, []);
      if (width === 1440) {
        assert(Math.abs(layout.row.height - 256) < 1, 'desktop row height');
        assert(Math.abs(layout.image.width - 320) < 1, 'desktop photo width');
        assert(Math.abs(layout.image.height - 208) < 1, 'desktop photo height');
      }
      report.layouts.push({ browser: name, ...layout });
      if ([390, 900, 1440].includes(width)) {
        await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${name}-blog-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
      }
      await openArticle(page);
      const dialogLayout = await page.locator('.article-dialog').evaluate((dialog) => {
        const b = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
        const scroll = dialog.querySelector('.article-dialog__scroll');
        return { x: b.x, y: b.y, right: b.right, bottom: b.bottom, width: b.width, scrollWidth: scroll.scrollWidth, clientWidth: scroll.clientWidth, scrollHeight: scroll.scrollHeight, clientHeight: scroll.clientHeight };
      });
      assert(dialogLayout.x >= 0 && dialogLayout.y >= 0 && dialogLayout.right <= width + 1);
      assert(dialogLayout.bottom <= (width <= 700 ? 844 : 900) + 1);
      assert(dialogLayout.scrollWidth <= dialogLayout.clientWidth + 1);
      assert(dialogLayout.scrollHeight > dialogLayout.clientHeight);
      if ([390, 1440].includes(width)) {
        await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${name}-article-${width}.png`) });
      }
      const toolbarTop = (await page.locator('.article-dialog__toolbar').boundingBox()).y;
      await page.locator('.article-dialog__scroll').evaluate((el) => { el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; });
      assert.equal((await page.locator('.article-dialog__toolbar').boundingBox()).y, toolbarTop);
      await page.locator('.article-dialog__cta').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
      assert(await page.locator('.article-dialog__cta').isVisible());
      if (width === 390) await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${name}-article-390-bottom.png`) });
      await closeWithEscape(page);
      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.body.style.position), '');
      report.checks.push(`${name}: page + modal geometry, image loading, fixed toolbar at ${width}px`);
    }

    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
    await ready(page);
    for (let index = 0; index < 10; index++) {
      const button = page.locator('.article-row__open').nth(index);
      await button.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
      const y = await page.evaluate(() => scrollY);
      const buttonId = await button.getAttribute('id');
      const cover = await page.locator('.article-row__image').nth(index).getAttribute('src');
      await openArticle(page, index);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog__title').textContent(), titles[index]);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog__image').getAttribute('src'), cover);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog__section').count(), 3);
      assert.deepEqual(await page.locator('.article-dialog__section h3').allTextContents(), expectedArticles[index].sections.map((section) => section.heading));
      assert.deepEqual(await page.locator('.article-dialog__section p').allTextContents(), expectedArticles[index].sections.map((section) => section.body));
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog__source a').getAttribute('href'), expectedArticles[index].source.url);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog__source a').getAttribute('rel'), 'noopener noreferrer');
      await closeWithEscape(page);
      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.id), buttonId, 'opener focus restored');
      assert(Math.abs((await page.evaluate(() => scrollY)) - y) < 2, 'list scroll restored');
      report.checks.push(`${name}: article ${index + 1} exact full content, asset, source, Escape and focus/scroll return`);
    }

    await ready(page);
    await page.locator('.article-row__image').first().click();
    await page.locator('.article-dialog[open]').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.article-dialog__title').textContent(), titles[0]);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close article', exact: true }).click();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.article-dialog'));
    report.checks.push(`${name}: whole-row image click and close button`);

    await openArticle(page);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close article', exact: true }).focus();
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab');
    assert(await page.locator('.article-dialog__cta').evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement));
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    assert(await page.locator('.article-dialog__close').evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement));
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    assert(await page.locator('.article-dialog__scroll').evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement));
    await page.keyboard.press('PageDown');
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('.article-dialog__scroll').scrollTop > 0);
    await closeWithEscape(page);
    report.checks.push(`${name}: keyboard focus loop and keyboard article scrolling`);

    await openArticle(page);
    await page.mouse.click(5, 5);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.article-dialog'));
    await openArticle(page);
    await page.mouse.move(500, 200); await page.mouse.down();
    await page.mouse.move(5, 5); await page.mouse.up();
    assert(await page.locator('.article-dialog[open]').isVisible(), 'drag outside must not dismiss');
    await closeWithEscape(page);
    report.checks.push(`${name}: backdrop click closes, drag originating inside does not`);

    await ready(page);
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Read the Latest', exact: true }).click();
    await page.waitForFunction(() => location.hash === '#articles' && document.activeElement.id === 'articles');
    await ready(page, `${base}/blog#articles`);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.activeElement.id === 'articles');
    report.checks.push(`${name}: in-page CTA and direct hash navigation`);

    await openArticle(page, 2);
    await page.locator('.article-dialog__cta').click();
    await page.waitForURL('**/contact');
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.body.style.position), '');
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.history.state.usr.articleId), 'roof-repair-or-replacement');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('dialog[open]').count(), 0);
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => scrollY), 0);
    report.checks.push(`${name}: Contact routing, article context and scroll-lock cleanup`);

    await ready(page, 'http://127.0.0.1:4193/blog');
    await openArticle(page);
    await page.waitForTimeout(200);
    assert(await page.locator('.article-dialog[open]').isVisible(), 'StrictMode keeps the dialog open');
    await closeWithEscape(page);
    report.checks.push(`${name}: React StrictMode open and close`);

    await context.close();
    const touch = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, hasTouch: true, isMobile: true });
    const phone = await touch.newPage();
    await ready(phone);
    await phone.locator('.article-row__open').first().tap();
    await phone.locator('.article-dialog[open]').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await phone.evaluate(() => document.body.style.position), 'fixed');
    await phone.locator('.article-dialog__scroll').evaluate((el) => { el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; });
    await phone.locator('.article-dialog__close').tap();
    await phone.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('.article-dialog'));
    assert.equal(await phone.evaluate(() => document.body.style.position), '');
    await touch.close();
    report.checks.push(`${name}: touch viewport open, read and close`);
    assert.deepEqual(errors, [], `${name} runtime errors`);
  } catch (error) {
    report.failures.push({ browser: name, message: String(error), stack: error.stack });
    try { await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${name}-failure.png`) }); } catch {}
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}
await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, 'report.json'), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify({ checks: report.checks.length, layouts: report.layouts.length, failures: report.failures, assetBytes: report.assets.reduce((n, a) => n + a.bytes, 0) }, null, 2));
if (report.failures.length) process.exitCode = 1;
